_doc: Danh sach cum va may chu ma man 'Chon May Chu' hien (KLoginServer.gd). Cung hinh dang voi serverlist.ini cua client cu: moi cum co ten va cac may chu {title, address}. address la thu KNetAddress hieu: host:port, tls://host:port, ws://host:port/ws, wss://host/ws. Ban tren may nguoi choi (user://serverlist.json) duoc uu tien hon tep nay.
